title: Evaluation of Dimensional Accuracy of 3D printed mandibular model using two different Additive Manufacturing Techniques based on Cone Beam Computed Tomography scan data (A Diagnostic Accuracy Study)
protocol: Apply radio opaque markers to the models.
Perform CBCT scanning of the model.
Convert DICOM files into STL format.
Record the same 10 linear measurements on the printed models.
Compare recorded values between 3D printed models and reference, as well as among each other.
